slides.texte_overlay:
weird things magnetic people
do without realising

they remember your story

they bring up something you told them weeks ago, like your sister's wedding or your exam. being remembered is so rare that people never forget the ones who do it.

they enjoy small talk

they treat small talk like a game instead of a chore. asking about the best thing in someone's week turns a boring chat into a moment people actually enjoy.

they leave space

they let others finish their stories, even the long ones, without jumping in. people feel heard around them, and feeling heard is the strongest pull there is.

they always know something

they spend a few minutes a day learning about the world: art, history, science. there's always something interesting in their head, and people love being around that.
slides.texte_sophia:
they always know something

they spend 5 minutes a day learning about art, history or science. the Sophia app makes it one short lesson a day, and there's always something interesting in their head.

slides.texte_overlay:
they're the same with everyone

they talk to the waiter the way they talk to the boss. people notice that kind of steadiness, and it makes everyone around them trust them a little more.
